observations: 2026-08-10: the Colts' first unofficial preseason depth chart (released ahead of Thursday's opener at New England) lists the RB order as Jonathan Taylor, DJ Giddens (RB2), Seth McGowan (RB3), Ulysses Bentley IV, Anderson Castle, Roydell Williams — no 'OR' designations (colts.com, 08-10).

2026-08-05: with DJ Giddens missing practice (hamstring), McGowan took first-team offensive reps alongside Jonathan Taylor and broke off several big runs (SI/On SI Colts, 08-05). 107.5 The Fan (08-10): with Giddens sidelined 'around a week or so', McGowan 'has flashed in an expanded role'.

2026-08-10 quotes: Jonathan Taylor: 'Everybody thinks he's just like a big power back, but Seth has some moves... he reminds me of like a David Montgomery... great feet, great vision.' Daniel Jones: 'a strong, physical runner... he's done a good job, has run hard.' OC Jim Bob Cooter: 'He's had a nice start... doing a really nice job of when he gets carries, sort of reading those runs' — with 'a couple young-guy hiccups' also noted (Yahoo, 08-10).

Draft context (2026-04-25): Colts selected McGowan in Round 7, No. 237 overall out of Kentucky (colts.com); GM Chris Ballard, asked about McGowan's 2021 criminal case: 'Look, I'm a second chance guy' (Heavy, 04-25).
inferences: Directional mechanism (pre-baseline, preserved as inference): upward contingent-opportunity pressure in the backup competition — camp momentum and teammate/coach corroboration point up while the formal chart still orders Giddens ahead. The contradiction is the signal and is preserved unresolved (TRUST ?).
McGowan is NOT recorded as RB2: the current chart explicitly lists Giddens second, and experience-with-team is the analyst-suggested tiebreaker.
